request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app concept for an interactive beginner music-theory course. Create a straight-on 16:9 browser viewport screenshot, no device frame. Product language is Chinese. Exact visible title: “听见乐理”. Layout concept: an explorable music-theory atlas. A slim app header sits above a large continuous concept map on the left two-thirds, connecting the six open chapters “琴键与声音”, “音程”, “音阶与调”, “三和弦”, “调内和弦”, “和弦进行”; every chapter shows small clickable lesson nodes and none are locked. The selected node “C 大调的七个和弦” opens a substantial experiment panel on the right with clickable I C, ii Dm, iii Em, IV F, V G, vi Am, vii° Bdim, a C E G construction readout, and play/stop actions. A precise two-octave piano is docked across the bottom, with C E G highlighted in muted terracotta and the root marked with a small non-color symbol. Map connections must be legible and purposeful, not playful bubbles. Style: Flight's quiet utilitarian editorial family, warm paper #f4f1ea, ink #20201d, muted moss #68735f, single terracotta accent #d46b45, flat surfaces, index tabs and fine relationship lines, restrained geometry, no shadows, no gradients. Serious adult learning tool, not a game. No gamification, no streaks, no progress bars, no locked lessons, no badges, no mascots, no childish illustration, no generic dashboard cards, no purple. Keep the piano key geometry musically plausible.
